tools.name: recall_rp_memory
tools.description: Look up stored RP history that the supplied memories do not cover. It pays off when the next reply needs something exact from the past: the words of an old promise or confession, a number, name, gift or date from an earlier event, what a character was told long ago, or how an earlier scene between these two actually went. Ask one natural-language question about it. Skip it when the recent conversation and supplied memories already give what the reply needs. Results are evidence with scene context and dialogue; they do not confirm the question's premise or give a character knowledge. For more detail in a supplied memory, use expand_rp_memory.

query.description: A natural-language question about stored roleplay history.

tools.name: expand_rp_memory
tools.description: Open one supplied memory ref to get its details, dialogue and source evidence. It pays off when the reply will quote or build on that record: the exact lines spoken, a detail the summary leaves out, or who was there. Optional focus narrows the result to matching evidence inside this memory and may return nothing; it never searches other memories. Refs from earlier responses in this chat stay valid. If you are not sure which record holds it, use recall_rp_memory. Records without a "Plot:" line are folded: they show only the lines that brought them up. Expand one by its ref to read the whole event.

ref.description: The exact ref supplied beside a memory.

focus.description: Optional detail to look for within this memory.
